summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 new Botao features. All 3 features PASS. (1) Leaderboard on /cidadela renders with 8 rows; THIAGO GARCIA DOS SANTOS at #1 with 804 soberania, top 3 have medal icons and highlighted rows, team badge with colors, coach name + nivel (IDOLO/APRENDIZ), title/W-L stats, and large soberania badge on right. (2) TitleCeremony via ?debug_ceremony=1 with seeded localStorage career: after clicking Futebol de Botao card, full-screen overlay shows golden pulsating trophy, 'CERIMONIA DE PREMIACAO', 'CAMPEAO DA COPA AMADOR', team name (MEU TIME), coach apelido (CACA), 3 stats (Soberania +120, Titulo 1o, Campanhas 1), heroic italic quote, and 'ERGUER A TACA' button with data-testid=ceremony-continue. canvas-confetti renders a <canvas> element and particles are visible in screenshot. (3) Ceremony closes correctly when button clicked (count goes from 1 to 0). (4) Code integration for Carreira Online in OnlineMatchV3.tsx handleFinish (lines 384-415) confirmed: calls aplicarResultadoRemoto(gf, ga, null) then inserirManchetesRemotas with generated headline; imports present in file.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing warnings observed but non-blocking as noted by main agent: 'Multiple GoTrueClient instances' and a 400 resource error (likely Supabase RPC for unmigrated column). Leaderboard uses fallback query correctly (titulos_treinador shows as 0 due to unmigrated columns).
TitleCeremony effect deps: useEffect([]) does not depend on props; fine since instance is remounted per showCeremony. Confetti frame loop correctly cancels on unmount.
seed_data_creation: Injected localStorage key 'botao:career:v1' with test coach (Cacá) to trigger debug ceremony flow. No backend data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3 features validated on public URL. Leaderboard reads botao_usuarios with fallback for unmigrated coach_* columns. Debug ceremony trigger requires both ?debug_ceremony=1 AND career.coach.nome present in localStorage 'botao:career:v1' AND user must navigate into BotaoGame (click Futebol de Botao card). The 400 network error on load appears related to Supabase RPC for a not-yet-migrated column and is expected per main agent context.
